plugins.name: agent-companion
plugins.description: Claude runs as manager and consults several independent verifier agents in parallel — each returns its own verdict. Manager mode survives compaction, and the panel is fed the project's own convention skills.

plugins.name: auditing-prs
plugins.description: Audit GitHub PRs from one shared detection core: audit-pr fetches, drafts, and publishes review comments with consistent conventions and resolves issues when fixes land; prepush-audit is a read-only, chat-only self-check an executor runs before pushing to surface the same findings first. Optional agent-companion verifier panel for independent task-completion checks.

plugins.name: knowledge
plugins.description: Stack-independent base for the developer's coding-knowledge plugins: capture loop + human-gated codification + notify-only pattern observer.

plugins.name: knowledge-vue
plugins.description: The developer's Vue conventions as intent-triggered skills over shared Vue core rules, with SEO auto-application (baseline SEO by default) and module-graph integrity rules (import cycles, god-modules, dead modules, layer leakage). Depends on the knowledge base and knowledge-seo plugins.

plugins.name: knowledge-seo
plugins.description: Stack-independent SEO conventions (meta, structured data, robots, sitemaps, social previews, Core Web Vitals, IndexNow) for baseline-by-default SEO. Policy knowledge only — on-demand project-wide SEO auditing moved to `auditing:seo` (`/plugin install auditing@claude-skills`).

plugins.name: knowledge-principles
plugins.description: Ten always-on programming rules as intent-triggered skills: clarity, abstraction timing, boy-scout cleanup, module boundaries, errors, state, naming, performance, security, change safety. Every rule states what it does not claim, so the consolidation it performs is recorded rather than hidden. Two shared core docs fix how the rules apply: precedence (a codified project convention always beats a universal principle) and proportionality (which rules are active for throwaway code, application code, and a new public surface). Stack-independent — per-rule Vue and Laravel references illustrate the rule in a framework's shape, never a project's conventions.

plugins.name: planning
plugins.description: Plan-then-build workflow: brainstorm a task into a self-contained plan, then implement that plan in a fresh session. Container for planning/workflow skills.

plugins.name: auditing
plugins.description: On-demand audits of a WHOLE application, one domain per perspective plus a dispatcher that runs several at once: audit (dispatcher), security, performance, accessibility, reliability, code-quality, data, api-contracts, business-analysis, seo, and remediate (turns a report into a plan). An audit never changes code — it writes reports under docs/audit/ and nothing else (the repository's CLAUDE.md included in what it never touches). Every domain runs on three knowledge tiers and no domain hard-requires a knowledge plugin: a missing tier degrades the run and is disclosed in the report's coverage section. Stack detection is deterministic: a bundled read-only python3 script emits the snapshot as JSON per unit, so a domain never guesses which surfaces a project has. Optional agent-companion verifier panel, dispatcher-only. Audits of PR diffs and changes belong to the auditing-prs plugin.

plugins.name: terse
plugins.description: Injects terse output-style rules into every session via a SessionStart hook: brevity and clarity weighted equally, a one-line restate of how a new task was understood, one idea per sentence with no invented vocabulary, questions strictly one at a time.
